objects.name: base
objects.prompt:
A single ruined Victorian chapel seen from directly above: a collapsed slate roof with broken
rafters open over the nave, soot-blackened stone walls, a boarded door on the south side and
boarded windows. One building only, filling the frame. Dark soot-black and wet grey stone,
never orange-brown. No ground, no rubble, no plinth, no shadow — the chapel alone on empty
background. Make the roof the largest thing in the picture.
